description: Minimum-free-energy secondary structure (Zuker DP traceback, Turner 2004, dangles d2; ViennaRNA RNAfold counterpart): dot-bracket, base pairs and MFE (kcal/mol, equals minimum_free_energy).

rnaSequence.description: RNA sequence (T read as U, case-insensitive; other characters never pair)

minLoopSize.description: Minimum hairpin loop size (default 3; values <3 are clamped, as ViennaRNA md.min_loop_size)

sequence.description: Upper-cased sequence, T read as U

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
